notes.title: Gameplay and Graphics Update
notes.notes:
Spark & Sparkle has an update!


[b]Game balance has received a significant update - Catching up to an opponent's progress after falling behind now works much better.[/b]


Also, a slight renovation to visuals for stage backgrounds, with some extra detail.


...And there are more additions we'd like to make soon, like more special capsules, and some new monsters!


Thank you very much for playing, everyone! As always, please let us know if you have any thoughts, questions, or suggestions!



[i]Version 1.4.1 [/i]
----------------------------
[list]
[*]Adjusted game balance
[*]Updated visuals for stage backgrounds
[*]Updated support for PS5 DualSense controller
[*]Additional measures to prevent the "stuck capsule" visual bug in online mode
[/list]
----------------------------

notes.title: 50 Puzzle Update!
notes.notes:
Spark & Sparkle has 50 new puzzles! 10 of them have been added to the puzzles which are available by default, and the other 40 have been added to the puzzles unlockable by earning pieces as you play the game.

We've also made a few fixes and adjustments throughout the game.



Here are some patch notes:

[i]Version 1.3.6[/i]
----------------------------
[list]
[*] Added 50 new puzzles (10 initially unlocked, 40 unlockable)
[*] Adjusted scoring system in Arcade Mode
[*] Adjusted analogue stick sensitivity for controllers
[*] Fixed some bugs
[/list]
----------------------------

As always, thank you for playing!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2.4
notes.notes:
[i]Version 1.2.4[/i]
----------------------------
Fixed V Sync issue introduced with Windows update version 2004
----------------------------

Some players have recently encountered a problem with the game running slowly. We hope this update remedies the issue completely.

Thank you to those who helped identify this issue.

notes.title: Spark & Sparkle now has Steam Achievements!
notes.notes:
Steam Achievements have been added to Spark & Sparkle!

You can unlock a few by just exploring the basics of the game, but of course there are also some that represent much more elusive accomplishments! We hope you enjoy discovering them!

As of the previous update, we've also improved the pace at which matches progress, and made some subtle changes which we believe greatly improve the game overall. You can check out the announcement preceding this one (it was version 1.1.1) to see those changes.

As always, thank you very much for playing! 




Here's the patch notes! Read on if you like patch notes!

[i]Version 1.2.3[/i]
----------------------------
[list]
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Added Steam Achievements
[*] Increased the duration of invulnerability players have after taking damage on the first two difficulty settings
[*] Visual and technical changes to the scanline and screen blur effects - They should now look better on more resolution settings, and impact game performance less
[*] Changed the way the game responds to the "Alt + Enter" shortcut - It now always defaults to the largest windowed resolution
[/list]
----------------------------

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.1
notes.notes:
[i]Version 1.1.1[/i]
----------------------------
[list]
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Adjusted CPU opponent behavior
[*] Adjusted some values associated with gems and earning capsules
[*] Adjusted match timer
[*] Reduced screen shake which occurs when a boss enemy is defeated
[/list]
----------------------------

We hope these subtle changes make the game a lot more fun.

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: 2 Free Standalone Music Albums Available Now!
notes.notes:
The Spark & Sparkle game soundtrack is available to download for free on Steam. Please check it out if you haven't already; It's free even if you don't own the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1291360/Spark_and_Sparkle_Soundtrack/

There's something new, too! Also now available: An additional album, "Extra Sounds", featuring alternate versions of some of the game's songs. We hope that you enjoy it. This album, too, can be downloaded for free.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1332230/Spark_and_Sparkle_Soundtrack_Extra_Sounds/

We hope you enjoy this variation of the game's music!
